data.long_meaning: The name Roby originates from the Greek word 'Robertos', which is derived from the Hebrew name 'Raphael'. It means 'Bright' or 'Famous'. In the Bible, Raphael is one of the archangels who healed Tobias and Sarah during their journey. The name Roby symbolizes courage, strength, and healing. The name Roby carries the meaning “Bright, famous” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Roby usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, famous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
